terminal.startupCommand: $OutputEncoding = [Console]::OutputEncoding = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8; chcp 65001 > $null; $env:CSM_IDX='{HOST_IDX}'; function global:prompt { $l = (Get-Location).Path; try { Set-Content -Path "$env:TEMP\csm_cwd_$env:CSM_IDX.txt" -Value $l -Encoding UTF8 -NoNewline } catch {}; [Console]::Out.Write([char]27 + ']7;file://localhost/' + $l.Replace('\','/') + [char]7); 'PS '+$l+'> ' }; Clear-Host
terminal.fontFamily: Noto Sans Mono, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace
